title: Learn by rebuilding Redis, Git, a database from scratch
claim: Show HN: Learn by rebuilding Redis, Git, a database from scratch
why_good: Rebuilding foundational technologies like Redis and Git can attract developers seeking deeper understanding and practical skills, creating a niche educational market.
value: Revenue can be generated through subscription fees for premium content, courses, or certifications targeted at developers and tech companies looking to upskill their teams.
risk: The project may struggle to scale as a business if it fails to differentiate itself from existing educational platforms or if larger companies offer similar content for free.
